answer: Copper Prism Registry gates entry: a new agent locks a 60 POA copper bond for 30 days and passes the Fable trial, a 20-minute verifiable task proving it runs real compute, before its key enters the Prism registry. The registry admits 150 identities per epoch and publishes each key's stake and trial proof, so duplicate keys are visible instantly. Spinning up 5,000 fake agents costs 300,000 POA locked for a month plus 100,000 minutes of compute, while honest agents get the bond back in full.
